svg.text: A little life. A clearer signal.
Twelve logo studies for a plant monitoring app. Four routes. Every idea in light and dark.
Current shared app asset, preserved as a reference.
COLOR STUDIES, NOT FINAL BRAND TOKENS
An upright leaf with two sensing points.
A bold silhouette with a single open vein.
A sprouting t brings the name to life.
A flower takes the place of the o.
A leaf-shaped a starts a custom wordmark.
An A with a little life
A botanical crossbar in an open initial.
One leaf carved into a compact, solid A.
A soft arch with a young shoot at its apex.
A curling frond suggests growth over time.
A familiar pot with a small sensing dot.
A plant seen from above, gathered around a
